string.name: phone_pair_ssh_key_help
string.value: Use the private key authorized on the SSH server. Its SHA-256 host fingerprint is confirmed before authentication.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_tls_help
string.value: Use the HTTPS Hub address on the pairing form. A pairing link supplies the Hub TLS public-key fingerprint (SPKI). For a typed address enter the 43-character fingerprint from the same Hub.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_public_help
string.value: Add the restricted line to the SSH server’s authorized_keys file to permit forwarding only to the Hub target. The private key stays on this device.
